enforcement_status.warning: This file is a specification reference for future CI gate design. It is NOT an enforced runtime system. Treating this as enforced will cause spec drift. No fetch wrapper, store middleware, route guard, or import guard has been injected into production code.
enforcement_status.freeze_rationale: YAGNI — zero runtime drift observed; v3 enforcement solves hypothetical problems with high invasive risk to 48 routes / 56 components / 4 stores

rules.description: Block UI calls to API endpoints not registered in contract-graph
rules.condition: fetch() target path NOT IN backend_endpoints registry
rules.action_warn: console.warn('[Contract] API endpoint not in graph: <path>')
rules.action_block: throw Error('[Contract] Blocked unregistered API call: <path>')

rules.description: Warn on response schema field drift (extra/missing fields vs declared type)
rules.action_warn: console.warn('[Contract] Response schema drift: <endpoint> expected <fields>, got <fields>')
rules.action_block: disabled (too noisy for production — warn only)

rules.description: Warn when component renders without data source binding
rules.condition: Component listed in api_consumers but no active useQuery/useEffect fetching data
rules.action_warn: console.warn('[Contract] Component <name> has API binding but no active fetch')

rules.description: Warn when store state field has no consumer reference
rules.condition: Store field NOT referenced by any component via useStore(selector)
rules.action_warn: console.warn('[Contract] Store field <store>.<field> has no consumer')
rules.action_block: disabled (state may be set for future use)

rules.description: Warn when page.tsx exists but route not in Sidebar navItems
rules.condition: app/<route>/page.tsx exists AND route NOT IN layout/Sidebar.tsx navItems
rules.action_warn: console.warn('[Contract] Route <path> not mounted in Sidebar')

rules.description: Block import of components not registered in contract graph
rules.condition: Component file exists in components/ BUT NOT IN api_consumers mapping
rules.action_block: throw Error('[Contract] Blocked orphan component: <path> — register in contract-graph first')
